headline: Russia strikes warehouses and food logistics, destroying up to 90% of capacity in places, but no shortage is expected – Ministry of Agriculture
summary: Russian attacks have destroyed up to 90% of modern storage capacity in some places in Ukraine. The Ministry of Agriculture said no systemic food shortage is expected.
why: Food storage and logistics capacity determines how grain and food supplies move domestically and to export markets, so losses matter for agricultural trade.
